regime_context: US market is in a narrow, non-one-narrative regime: Memory/HBM leads with a wide margin (2.60 vs 1.89 challenger), eligible breadth is squeezing to 20/49 themes, and the dominant 'semiconductors/AI' cluster shares a single SMH proxy across several ranked names. Momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0); the one validated leg — the absolute-trend gate — is active (gate_helps=true), so the honest read is 'trend condition positive, direction uncertain.' Track record shows decent hit rate (0.696) but coin-flip directional accuracy (0.506), so calibration stays modest.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the tight semi cluster (Memory/HBM, AI Infra, WFE, AI Semis all proxied by SMH) remains a single undifferentiated leadership or whether SMH's breadth begins to thin below 0.7 — the condition that retires the watch is AI Infrastructure closing the rotation margin to under 0.3 with Memory/HBM, which would signal a genuine internal handoff rather than cluster noise.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The headline theme is eligible (absolute-trend gate passing), has trend health (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.71), healthy breadth (0.75), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.41). The trend-gate leg is the only validated risk-control edge, so the lean is primarily a stay-in-trend conditional, not a return forecast. Cross-sectional rank is an attention lens; I am not extrapolating leadership into alpha.
evidence: rotation leader margin 0.718 (confirmed leadership, not a handoff signal)
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM is highly cyclical and sentiment-driven; a rank-IC ~0 lens means peak relative strength can coincide with peak positioning, and the SMH proxy blends it with multiple other semi themes, so 'leadership' may be a same-cluster artifact rather than idiosyncratic endurance.

falsifier.text: SMH price closes below its 10-week (50-day) moving average on the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Rank 2 and eligible with solid breadth (0.792) and trend-mixed health. This is a stay-in-trend conditional tied to the absolute-trend gate, not a momentum alpha call. Cohesion with Memory/HBM makes this a cluster read rather than an independent idea.
evidence: challenger in rotation with margin nearby
theses.dissent: Sharing the SMH proxy with Memory/HBM, AI Semiconductors, and WFE means the 'theme' is not cleanly separable; if semis mean-revert broadly, this lean offers no diversification from the headline call.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 3 and eligible, but crowded=true (crowding_z=1.92). Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade or short. Given coin-flip directional accuracy and the explicit guardrail against fading on crowding, the accountable stance is simply to avoid leaning into a crowded, fully-extended theme while it is this stretched.
evidence: guardrail: crowding is a sizing caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level drawdown forward edge; a crowded trend can persist (reflexivity), and breadth=1.0 plus durability_bar=0.78 is actually the healthiest texture on the board, so 'avoid' risks missing continuation.

falsifier.text: CIBR makes a new 20-day high while breadth stays at 1.0 before the check-by date
